verdict.rationale: Sardine says it runs inline sanctions checks at authorization to screen senders or receivers before funds are released. It auto-clears low-risk matches and escalates real exposure with explainable scores, routing higher-risk matches to analysts in a case management workspace for review. That covers screening a payment pre-release and inspecting the decision and its matches. Missing for 10: technical docs or an API reference showing the per-payment decision payload and match-level detail (matched list entries, scores, fields), and independent or hands-on confirmation; the evidence is mostly marketing-page claims.
